name: Content Translation Redirect
description: Allows users to redirect from a non-existent content translation.
project_description:
This module will be useful if you need to redirect users from pages of

non-existent content translations.

 Features 
 
 Default redirect settings. 
 Redirect settings for content entity types and bundles. 
 Redirect to original content or specified path. 
 Act on translatable and untranslatable entities. 
 Integration with page cache to optimize performance. 
 Control redirect via event. 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Navigate to Administration > Configuration > Regional and language >

Content translation redirects. 
 Configure redirects for content entity types and bundles. 
 
 Similar modules 
 
 Content Language Access helps when you have a content that needs to have access restriction by language.
